_comment: Narrow exemptions for denylist-check.py. Every entry needs a reason. history-file entries are legal ONLY under docs/** and plans/** -- the gate hard-fails otherwise, so widening that surface is a visible change to the gate itself.

entries.reason: The canonical findings document. It must be able to quote the identifiers it reports (F008, F039, F172); redacting the findings would make the audit unreadable.
Spike memos quote what they found. Pre-emptive: currently clean.

ADRs must be able to name the pre-fork package to record the naming decision (issue #6). Pre-emptive: docs/adr/ does not exist yet, so this suppresses nothing today and is kept so the first ADR that needs it is not ambushed by the gate.
Roadmap acceptance criteria quote the literals they require removed. Segment-strict on purpose: NOT plans/**, so plans/README.md and plans/*/issue-map.json stay gated.
Duplicate of the plans/*/roadmap.yaml rule, kept explicit because this file also carries the project-map.json replacement criterion.

The employer product key on this line was 'left at its original value deliberately when the kit was genericized' (see the comment immediately above it), and it is hashed into stored catalog digests, so changing it may invalidate existing rows. That is an OWNER DECISION tracked as issue #267, not a sweep. Remove this entry when #267 is decided.
